text:
hana: Quick note - found a flaky parity bug in the py async SDK while chaining embeddings -> rerank with the new batching helper. Under concurrency the rerank result sometimes comes back as a single wrapped object instead of a list, which breaks our sample app that expects per-query lists.
vijay: ugh. can you show the minimal repro?
hana: minimal async flow:
```python
async with AsyncClient(api_key=TOKEN) as c:
    es = await c.embeddings.create_batch(doc_texts)
    rr = await c.rerank.create_batch(queries, candidates=es)
```
expect rr to be List[List[RerankScore]] but intermittently it's a dict like {"scores": [...], "meta": {...}}. Happens more under load.
marco: do you have logs/traces?
hana: logs show token refresh around same time:
INFO 2026-06-11 09:01:11 batcher: dispatch subbatch id=bz7
ERROR 2026-06-11 09:01:11 auth: refresh token triggered for org=delta
WARN 2026-06-11 09:01:11 rerank: fallback_response_builder used for subbatch bz7
marco: that fallback builder predates new rerank shapes and returns a compact object. Batcher should normalize after merging responses.
vijay: also noticed async client types in stubs are loose (Any) while sync client is typed List[RerankGroup]. That allows this to slip through mypy.
hana: quick unblock: patched sampleapp with a defensive normalizer from redwood.utils to coerce shape. ugly but works for demos.
marco: plan: 1) change fallback_response_builder to emit canonical list-of-lists, 2) add normalize helper at batcher boundary, 3) align async/sync typing signatures and add mypy job for examples, 4) add integration test simulating token rotation mid-batch.
vijay: I'll take typing PR + CI job. marco: can you own fallback+test? hana: can you attach repro and logs to an issue?
hana: done - added small pytest that simulates token rotate and the logs.
sdk-bot: Created issue #4219: "py-sdk: async batcher may return singleton-wrapped rerank responses during auth refresh" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4219)
vijay: thanks. I'll add a tiny exported helper normalize_rerank(resp) in redwood.utils.batch and run mypy across samples.
marco: adding unit test to assert idempotency of normalize and that final shape matches sync client. leaving thread open until PRs merge.
hana: thanks team! will remove the sampleapp patch after fix lands :sparkles:
